decisions.proposed_text: Mức độ hoàn thiện lại cao hơn nữa...!\nQuả không hổ danh Trainer.

decisions.reason: The cumulative daily effort being genuinely absorbed by her is conveyed accurately with preserved line structure.

The praise and expectation of even greater future performance are accurately conveyed.

decisions.reason: The source says the dedicated/assigned person rather than explicitly naming an Uma Musume; removing the added species label is more faithful and natural.

The embedded generic Speed-stat rule incorrectly fires on 速度 in ordinary prose meaning growth rate; resolving this safely requires a canonical context exclusion rather than changing correct prose to the stat label Speed.
decisions.terminology_basis: Current prose meaning is 'tốc độ trưởng thành', not the gameplay Speed stat; the embedded common.stat.speed guard is overmatching.

canonical_finding.concept: Generic Speed stat alias must not match ordinary prose phrases such as 成长速度 (growth rate)
canonical_finding.reason: The generic stat guard overmatches non-stat prose and would force an incorrect player-facing Speed label into ordinary dialogue.

decisions.proposed_text: Đại diện cho giới đua ngựa\nchính là cặp Mã Nương và Trainer này nhỉ!
decisions.reason: Meaning is preserved, but both embedded player-facing terminology rules are violated in the current target.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.world.umamusume requires Mã Nương and common.trainer requires Trainer.
